name: discovery-skin
description: A research-discovery madlib: the human states a question and its constraints (spoken); novelty/parsimony/risk axes and a guardrail nudge accumulate the unspoken field; the word-smith LLM proposes the next concrete falsifiable move.

cells.prompt: What are you researching? (one falsifiable question)
Time budget for the next probe?
What must the probe NOT touch or assume?

cells.doc: novelty prior drawn from the question and the situation dice
shorter questions tend to be crisper; how testable the question reads
constraint gravity: how heavy the taboo is
risk appetite amplifies the reach of the probe
crisp questions admit cheaper, sharper probes

cells.expr: sway("risk|" + shape) * (budget == "one long night" ? 1.0 : budget == "one quarter" ? 0.7 : budget == "one week" ? 0.5 : 0.3)
cells.doc: budget buys depth of the dive
the taboo pulls the field back; empty taboo leaves it free
the discovery tension: reach vs economy, felt together

cells.instruction: Propose the next concrete discovery move for the question: a one-line HYPOTHESIS, a FALSIFICATION TEST cheap enough for the stated budget, and the MINIMUM EVIDENCE that settles it. Honor the nudge vector: high novelty reaches for a surprising consequence, high parsimony keeps the test minimal, risk sets how bold the design may be, guardrail marks where the taboo bites. Do not name the axes or the numbers.
cells.fallback_shape: A {adj} probe: test the sharpest consequence of {question}; kill it cheaply before scaling; the taboo stays untouched: {taboo}.
cells.doc: the ONLY LLM cell — last-mile word-smithing over the accumulated unspoken field
